# Report information

Focused **general identification-QC** report (ID counts, size distributions and
motifs) for immunopeptidomics experiments, provided by the Immunopeptidomics
Platform (IPP).

**Sample Set:** `r params$SampleSet`

**Data Analysis: ** `r params$DataAnalysisNames`

**Date:**  `r Sys.Date()`

**Code version:** `r packageVersion("HowMaHiCo")`

```{r child = system.file("rmarkdown", "shared", "setup.Rmd", package = "HowMaHiCo")}
```


## Total IDs with decoys, DeNovo and contaminants

This evaluation includes all peptides identified, without filtering out peptides that were not assigned to any protein or peptides that could come from contaminant proteins (Accession labeled Cont_). These values are shown below. Some true peptides can be originated from proteins typically assigned as contaminant in proteomics experiments (e.g., actins, keratins, albumins, etc.).

```{r check-ids-global, echo=FALSE}
check_ids_global(pep_all) |>
  kable() |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)
```

# Identification counts

```{r counts-all, echo=FALSE}

counts_levels <- c("Peptides", "Sequences", "Proteins")

# Counts all peptides
## Sample
counts_all <- pep_all |>
  group_by(Condition, BioReplicate, Sample) |>
  summarise(n_Peptides = n_distinct(Peptide),
            n_Sequences = n_distinct(Sequence),
            n_Proteins = n_distinct(Accession),
            .groups = "drop")

## Condition average
counts_all_mean <-
  counts_all |>
  group_by(Condition) |>
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),
                   list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                   sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE))),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
## Condition total
counts_all_total <- pep_all |>
  group_by(Condition) |>
  summarise(n_Peptides = n_distinct(Peptide),
            n_Sequences = n_distinct(Sequence),
            n_Proteins = n_distinct(Accession),
            .groups = "drop")

## BioReplicate per TechReplicate
counts_all_overlap <-
  pep_all |>
  filter(Area != 0) |>
  count(Condition,  Accession, Peptide, Sequence, name = "n_Samples") |>
  mutate(n_Samples = factor(paste0(n_Samples, " Rep."))) |>
  group_by(Condition, n_Samples) |>
  summarise(n_Peptides = n_distinct(Peptide),
            n_Sequences = n_distinct(Sequence),
            n_Proteins = n_distinct(Accession),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  full_join(rename_with(counts_all_total, ~gsub("n_", "total_", .x)), by = "Condition") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Condition, n_Samples), names_to = "Type_Level", values_to = "n") |>
  separate(Type_Level, sep = "_", into = c("Type", "Level")) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Condition, n_Samples, Level), values_from = "n", names_from = "Type") |>
  arrange(Condition, Level, desc(n_Samples)) |>
  group_by(Condition, Level) |>
  mutate(perc = paste0("", round(100*(n/total), 1), "%"),
         cum = cumsum(n)) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Condition, n_Samples), names_from = Level, values_from = all_of(c("n", "perc", "cum",  "total")))

## Limits for plots
count_lim <- data.frame(Level = c("Peptides", "Sequences", "Proteins"),
                        Limit_mean = c( ceiling((max(counts_all$n_Peptides)*1.2/100))*100,
                                   ceiling((max(counts_all$n_Sequences)*1.2/100))*100,
                                   ceiling((max(counts_all$n_Proteins)*1.3/100))*100),
                        Limit_total = c( ceiling((max(counts_all_total$n_Peptides)*1.2/100))*100,
                                   ceiling((max(counts_all_total$n_Sequences)*1.2/100))*100,
                                   ceiling((max(counts_all_total$n_Proteins)*1.2/100))*100))

### adaptation for running with all way of plotting for the overlaps

npep_ylim <- count_lim[count_lim$Level == "Peptides", "Limit_mean"]
nseq_ylim <- count_lim[count_lim$Level == "Sequences", "Limit_mean"]
nprot_ylim <- count_lim[count_lim$Level == "Proteins", "Limit_mean"]
npep_ylim_total <- count_lim[count_lim$Level == "Peptides", "Limit_total"]
nseq_ylim_total <- count_lim[count_lim$Level == "Sequences", "Limit_total"]
nprot_ylim_total <- count_lim[count_lim$Level == "Proteins", "Limit_total"]


# By LengthRange
## Sample
counts_size <-
  bind_rows(counts_all |>
              mutate(Length_range =  "All peptides"),
            pep_all |>
              group_by(Condition, BioReplicate, Sample, Length_range) |>
              summarise(n_Peptides = n_distinct(Peptide),
                        n_Sequences = n_distinct(Sequence),
                        n_Proteins = n_distinct(Accession),
                        .groups = "drop") |>
              arrange(Sample))  |>
  #arrange factors in a logical way
  mutate(Length_range = factor(Length_range,
                               levels = c("All peptides", "others", paste0(shortpep_range[1], " to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs"))))

## Condition average
counts_size_mean <-
  counts_size |>
  group_by(Condition, Length_range) |>
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),
                   list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                        sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE))),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
## Condition total
counts_size_total <-
  bind_rows(counts_all_total |>
              mutate(Length_range =  "All peptides"),
            pep_all |>
              group_by(Condition, Length_range) |>
              summarise(n_Peptides = n_distinct(Peptide),
                        n_Sequences = n_distinct(Sequence),
                        n_Proteins = n_distinct(Accession),
                        .groups = "drop")) |>
  #arrange factors in a logical way
  mutate(Length_range = factor(Length_range,
                               levels = c("All peptides", "others", paste0(shortpep_range[1], " to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs"))))

# Per-sample y-axis limits
counts_all_sample <- counts_size |> dplyr::filter(Length_range == "All peptides")
count_lim$Limit_sample <- c(
  ceiling(max(counts_all_sample$n_Peptides)  * 1.2 / 100) * 100,
  ceiling(max(counts_all_sample$n_Sequences) * 1.2 / 100) * 100,
  ceiling(max(counts_all_sample$n_Proteins)  * 1.2 / 100) * 100
)
```



## Peptides identified per charge +1 to +4 {.tabset}

```{r charge-proportion-data, echo=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# Build the charge-state proportion table for a given peptide set (all or selected)
.charge_prop_table <- function(pep) {
  bind_rows(
    pep |>
      get_charge_group() |>
      group_by(Condition, Charge_group) |>
      count_ids() |>
      arrange(Condition, Charge_group),
    pep |>
      get_charge_group() |>
      group_by(Condition) |>
      count_ids() |>
      mutate(Charge_group = "Total")
  ) |>
    mutate(Charge_group = factor(Charge_group, rev(unique(Charge_group)))) |>
    get_proportion_charge()
}

prop_all_condition_charge   <- .charge_prop_table(pep_all)
prop_short_condition_charge <- .charge_prop_table(pep_short)

bp_prop_all_condition_charge <-
  prop_all_condition_charge |>
  plot_charge_proportions(Condition) +
  rotate_x_text(70) +
  ggtitle("Charge proportion all peptides")
bp_prop_short_condition_charge <-
  prop_short_condition_charge |>
  plot_charge_proportions(Condition) +
  rotate_x_text(70) +
  ggtitle("Charge proportion selected peptides")

# check if % > 100, per set (peptides can be reported with multiple charge states)
tmp_prop_total <-
  bind_rows(all = prop_all_condition_charge, short = prop_short_condition_charge, .id = "set") |>
  filter(Charge_group != "Total") |>
  group_by(set, Condition, Level) |>
  summarise(Proportion_Total = sum(Proportion), .groups = "drop")
if(any(tmp_prop_total$Proportion_Total > 1)){
  warning("The total percentage is > 100% in some cases. This may be because some peptides can be reported with multiple charge states (e.g. in Fragpipe)")
}
rm(tmp_prop_total)
```

## Summary table

```{r table-pep-size-summary, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pep_all_unique_mz |>
  select(Condition, Length, Mass, m_z) |>
  group_by(Condition) |>
  # summarise(Min = min(Length))
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), c(min = ~min(.x, na.rm=TRUE),
                                        q1 = ~quantile(.x, na.rm=TRUE)[2],
                                        median = ~median(.x, na.rm=TRUE),
                                        q3 = ~quantile(.x, na.rm=TRUE)[3],
                                        max = ~max(.x, na.rm=TRUE))),  .groups = "drop")  |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Condition") |>
  t()
```


# Peptide motifs {.tabset}

Sequence logos are shown below, separated by sequence length, without any clustering or deconvolution. [Wagih, Omar. ggseqlogo: a versatile R package for drawing sequence logos. Bioinformatics (2017). https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btx469]


```{r plot-seqlogo, echo=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
# seq_lengths_short <- sort(unique(pep_short$Length))
seq_lengths_short <- sort(unique(pep_all$Length)[unique(pep_all$Length) <= 24]) # this helps skiping lengths with 0 peptides to avoid errors

motifs_pepshort <- lapply(seq_lengths_short, function(x){
  # print(x)
    ggseqlogo_bylength(pep_all, seq_length = x, by = "Condition", ncol = phis_ncol) +
                            theme(text = element_text(size = 8))

})
names(motifs_pepshort) <- seq_lengths_short

for (i in 1:length(motifs_pepshort)) {
  cat("\n### Length = ", names(motifs_pepshort)[i],"\n")
  motifs_pepshort[i]  |>  print()
  cat('\n\n')
}
```

```{r export-results, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Always-written export: render parameters + the main long table and summaries

write.csv_rawr(counts_pep_all_condition, folder = FolderResults)

if (params$CsvSave) {
  write.csv_rawr(counts_all, folder = FolderResults)
  write.csv_rawr(counts_all_mean, folder = FolderResults)
  write.csv_rawr(counts_all_total, folder = FolderResults)
  write.csv_rawr(counts_size, folder = FolderResults)
  write.csv_rawr(counts_size_mean, folder = FolderResults)

}

  ggsave_rawr(phist_peplength_density, "phist_peplength_density", folder = FolderFigures, width = n_conditions*1.5 + 2, height = 8)

  ggsave_rawr(bp_prop_all_condition_charge, file = "bp_prop_all_condition_charge", folder = FolderFigures, width = n_conditions + 5, height = 10)
  ggsave_rawr(bp_prop_short_condition_charge, file = "bp_prop_short_condition_charge", folder = FolderFigures, width = n_conditions + 5, height = 10)
  ggsave_rawr(bp_prop_length_pep_condition, file = "bp_prop_length_pep_condition", folder = FolderFigures, width = n_conditions + 5, height = 10)
  ggsave_rawr(bp_prop_length_pep_sample, file = "bp_prop_length_pep_sample", folder = FolderFigures, width = n_conditions + 5, height = 10)
```
